name: The Lost and the Damned
oracle_text: Whenever a land you control enters from anywhere other than your hand or you cast a spell from anywhere other than your hand, create a 3/3 red Spawn creature token.
blocked_sentences: Whenever a land you control enters from anywhere other than your hand or you cast a spell from anywhere other than your hand, create a 3/3 red Spawn creature token.

needs.what: a 3/3 red Spawn creature token (no abilities)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids has no 3/3 red Spawn: eldrazi_spawn_0_1_c is a 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn with a mana ability, and ogre_3_3_r / ape_villain_3_3_r_haste have the wrong creature type (and haste on the Ape).
